title: Computation Note on the Closing Settlement Amount — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Amount.** Under the Contingency Placement Agreements, the closing settlement payment on an agreement with a termination notice on record is the agreement's fees owed to Ridgeline on the day the payment is made, rounded to the cent.

## The quantity

The agreement's fees owed are the contingency fees and other charges the client owes Ridgeline on that agreement and has not yet paid: direct-pay fees, invoiced fees, recall fees, late charges and early-termination fees, less fee payments and credits. The figure is the fees owed balance shown on the agreement record on the day the payment is made, and it is read for that one agreement only; the fees owed on any other agreement of the same client do not enter it.

| Element | Effect on the fees owed |
|---|---|
| Direct-pay fees booked | raise it |
| Fee invoices booked | raise it |
| Recall fees booked | raise it |
| Late charges booked | raise it |
| Early-termination charge booked | raises it |
| Fee payments received | lower it |
| Fee credits issued | lower it |

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

An agreement's fees owed are made up of invoiced fees of 2400.00 USD, a recall fee of 312.40 USD, late charges of 54.86 USD and an early-termination charge of 1500.00 USD, less fee payments of 850.00 USD — 3417.26 USD on the day of payment. The closing settlement payment is 3417.26 USD.

An agreement with fees owed of 0.00 USD on the day of payment has a closing settlement payment of 0.00 USD.
